meta.title: WordPress Museum: 0.7
meta.description: A time-capsule post for WordPress 0.7, released May 27, 2003.
meta.author: wordpress-playground

steps.code:
<?php
// WordPress 0.7 is the b2/cafelog-era release: it predates both wp-load.php as a
// real loader and the $wpdb->posts table property. Playground ships a wp-load.php
// shim that pulls in b2config.php, which creates $wpdb (the SQLite integration)
// and sets the $tableposts global ('b2posts'). Bootstrap through it, then refresh
// the default first post in place using that table.
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

function wordpress_museum_sql_escape($value) {
	return str_replace("'", "''", $value);
}

$table = (isset($tableposts) && $tableposts) ? $tableposts : 'b2posts';
$title = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode('TXVzZXVtIERpc3BhdGNoOiBXb3JkUHJlc3MgMC43'));
$content = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode(''));
$now = '2003-05-27 10:00:00';
$wpdb->query(
	"UPDATE " . $table . " SET post_title = '$title', post_content = '$content', post_date = '$now' WHERE ID = 1"
);
